selected_observations.excerpt:
Counterparty: Oakfield Logistics GmbH
Effective: 1 September 2018
Term: rolling 12-month periods.
During the term, the provider is the exclusive warehousing contractor for the counterparty's German inbound freight.

selection_rationale: Exclusivity presence is determined by an explicit exclusivity section in MSA-OAK-2018.
known_missing_information: Non-exclusivity MSAs provide no positive exclusivity tuple; absence judgment follows KERNEL limitation on negation.
